chunks: Whosoever God allows to go astray has none to show him the way, for He leaves them to wander perplexed in their wickedness.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God causes someone to go astray and leaves them wandering?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-A'raf elucidates the interplay between divine decree (Qadr) and human free will, suggesting that persistent rejection of truth leads to a sealing of the heart where guidance becomes inaccessible. It highlights the consequence of 'tughyan' (transgression), where individuals are left to wander in confusion due to their own choices, a concept deeply explored by scholars like Al-Tabarsi and Al-Kulayni.
